title: 账单上有不认识的扣款，怎么办？
summary: 对账单发现可疑扣款：打电话给银行问明细、申诉，保护账户安全。

featuredPhrase.en: There's a charge I don't recognize.
featuredPhrase.zh: 有一笔我不认识的扣款。

phrases.en: There's a charge I don't recognize.
phrases.zh: 有一笔我不认识的扣款。

phrases.en: I think there's fraud on my account.
phrases.zh: 我觉得我的账户被盗刷了。

phrases.en: Can you print my last statement?
phrases.zh: 能打印我上个月的对账单吗？
能把这笔扣款退回来吗？

phrases.en: I want to dispute this transaction.
phrases.zh: 我要对这笔交易提出异议。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, there's a charge I don't recognize on my statement.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的对账单上有一笔不认识的扣款。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Can you tell me the date and amount?
dialogue.zh: 能告诉我日期和金额吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: October 5th, $89.99, from a store I've never heard of.
dialogue.zh: 10 月 5 号，89.99 美元，一家我没听过的店。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I see it. Would you like to dispute this transaction?
dialogue.zh: 看到了，要对这笔交易提出异议吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Can you reverse this charge?
dialogue.zh: 要，麻烦把这笔扣款退回来。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Done. You'll see the refund in 3 to 5 days.
dialogue.zh: 办好了，3 到 5 天会退款到账。
